title: Nā Mele: An Evening of Slack-Key with Honokaʻa Musicians
description: Live concert recording from July 12, 1985 featuring slack-key guitar and falsetto vocals from Honokaʻa-based musicians. Includes traditional mele and original compositions.

roku.short_description: Live slack-key and falsetto concert with Honokaʻa musicians, July 12, 1985.
roku.long_description: Live concert recording from July 12, 1985 featuring kī hōʻalu (slack-key guitar) and falsetto vocals from Honokaʻa-based musicians. Includes traditional mele and original compositions performed in front of a small community audience.
